### Flight List Response Structure {#flight-response-structure}

The flight search response contains comprehensive flight information
organized in a hierarchical structure. The response includes metadata
about the search, available flights with detailed routing information,
pricing details, and pagination data. Each flight option contains
multiple routes with detailed segment information including aircraft
details, timing, airports, carriers, and baggage allowances.

::: {.info-box}
::: {.info-box-content}
##### Key Point: \_embedded.flights Contains the Actual Results

The most important part of the response is the **\_embedded.flights**
array, which contains the actual flight options returned by the search.
Each object in this array represents a complete flight itinerary with
pricing, routing, and booking details that you\'ll use to display
options to users and process bookings.
:::
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Flight Response Fields

  Field                    Type      Description
  ------------------------ --------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  type                     integer   Search type identifier (1 = roundtrip, 2 = oneway, 3 = multi-destination)
  minPrice                 decimal   Lowest price found in the search results
  maxPrice                 decimal   Highest price found in the search results
  airlines                 array     List of airline names available in the search results
  airlinePriorities        object    Priority settings for each airline (can be used for sorting)
  airports                 array     List of airports involved in the search with codes, city names, and metadata
  airports\[\].Code        string    IATA airport code (e.g., \"LHR\", \"SYD\")
  airports\[\].City        string    City name where the airport is located
  airports\[\].Name        string    Full airport name
  airports\[\].\_data      object    Additional airport metadata (e.g., isDestinationAirport flag)
  stops                    array     Number of stops available in flight options
  departureTimes           array     Available departure time slots (in hours, 24-hour format)
  returnTimes              array     Available return time slots (in hours, 24-hour format)
  searchData               object    Original search parameters and criteria
  **\_embedded.flights**   array     **🔥 Array of available flight options - this contains the actual flight itineraries with pricing, routes, and booking details**
  page\_count              integer   Total number of pages available
  page\_size               integer   Number of items per page**All results will be retrieved on a single page by default.**
  total\_items             integer   Total number of flight options found
  page                     integer   Current page number
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### 🔥 Core Flight Data: Flight Object Fields (\_embedded.flights\[\])

**This table describes the structure of each flight option in the
results array - the actual data you\'ll use to display flight options
and process bookings.**

  Field                                   Type      Description
  --------------------------------------- --------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Price**                               decimal   **💰 ESSENTIAL: Total price for this flight option - use this for display and comparison**
  **Currency**                            string    **💰 ESSENTIAL: Currency code for the price (e.g., \"SAR\", \"USD\")**
  **ItineraryCode**                       string    **🔑 ESSENTIAL: Unique identifier for this specific itinerary - required for booking**
  **Routes**                              array     **✈️ ESSENTIAL: Array of route objects (outbound, return, etc.) - contains flight details**
  Combinations                            array     Available route combinations for this flight option (e.g., \"00\|10\", \"00\|11\")
  Routes\[\].Route                        array     Array of route segments for this direction
  Routes\[\].Route\[\].AirportChange      boolean   Whether an airport change is required during connection
  Routes\[\].Route\[\].MultipleAirlines   boolean   Whether multiple airlines are involved in this route
  Routes\[\].Route\[\].NextDayLanding     boolean   Whether the arrival is on the next day
  Routes\[\].Route\[\].Duration           string    Total duration of the route (format: \"HH:MM\")
  Routes\[\].Route\[\].Segment            array     Individual flight segments within this route
  Segment\[\].Aircraft.Code               string    Aircraft type code (e.g., \"388\", \"77W\", \"789\")
  Segment\[\].Flight.Number               string    Flight number
  Segment\[\].Flight.Class                string    Booking class code (e.g., \"Q\", \"Y\", \"J\")
  Segment\[\].Flight.Duration             string    Flight segment duration (format: \"HH:MM\")
  Segment\[\].Flight.CabinType            string    Cabin class (Economy, Business, First, premium, coach, Economy with restrictions, etc.)
  Segment\[\].Flight.StopTime             string    Layover time at connection airport (format: \"HH:MM:SS\")
  Segment\[\].Origin                      object    Departure airport and timing information
  Segment\[\].Origin.Date                 string    Departure date (format: \"YYYY-MM-DD\")
  Segment\[\].Origin.Time                 string    Departure time (format: \"HH:MM:SS\")
  Segment\[\].Origin.Terminal             string    Departure terminal
  Segment\[\].Origin.Airport              object    Departure airport details
  Segment\[\].Destination                 object    Arrival airport and timing information
  Segment\[\].Destination.Date            string    Arrival date (format: \"YYYY-MM-DD\")
  Segment\[\].Destination.Time            string    Arrival time (format: \"HH:MM:SS\")
  Segment\[\].Destination.Terminal        string    Arrival terminal
  Segment\[\].Carrier                     object    Airline information for this segment
  Segment\[\].Carrier.Marketing           object    Marketing airline (the airline selling the ticket)
  Segment\[\].Carrier.Operating           object    Operating airline (the airline actually operating the flight)
  Segment\[\].BaggageAllowance            array     Baggage allowance information by passenger type
  BaggageAllowance\[\].PTC                string    Passenger type code (ADT=Adult, CHD=Child, etc.)
  BaggageAllowance\[\].Allowed            string    Allowed baggage weight/pieces (e.g., \"0 KG\", \"23 KG\")
  PriceDetail                             object    Detailed pricing information
  PriceDetail.Amount                      decimal   Total price amount
  PriceDetail.Currency                    string    Currency code for the price
  BrandedFare                             object    Branded fare information if available
  BrandedFare.BrandDetails                array     Details about branded fare for each segment
  NonRefundable                           boolean   Whether the fare is non-refundable
  UpsellSupport                           boolean   Whether upsell options are available for this flight
  System                                  string    Supplier identifier (e.g., \"1A\" for Amadeus)
:::

Cabin Type Mapping {#flights-cabin-mapping}
------------------

TRIP admin allows you to map the cabin type received from the suppliers
under the main classes.

### Get The Classes

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/v3/flights/classes]{.url}
:::

After you have obtained the classes, you need to request the mapping
available for each and one of them by making a GET request to:

### Get Cabin Class Mapping

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/v3/flights/classes/:id/map]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description   Type     Parameter   Value
  ------------- -------- ----------- -------
  Cabin ID      string   {\$id}      1
:::

::: {.info-box}
::: {.info-box-content}
**Note:** The ID \"1\" is the ID received in the previous response and
for each class, you need to use the corresponding ID in order to obtain
the mapping.
:::
:::

After you have obtained all of these details, you can match the received
information with the details that you have from the suppliers in the
Flight results list, under the Cabin type property.

This way you can either display the cabin type information in a standard
way (using the main classes) or you can filter the results using the
main classes as filters and the mapping to browse and group the flight
results.

Validating a Flight {#flights-validate}
-------------------

After choosing a specific flight, we need to validate it and get more
information such as Fare Details and Fare Rules.

The validation is done using the search code, the itinerary code and the
combination index (Route Id).

### Understanding Combination Index (Route Id)

The combination index (Route Id) is identifiable using the below
information:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Flight Data Structure Example
:::

::: {.code-content}
    Combinations:
    [
    "00|10",
    "01|11",
    "02|11",
    ]
    Price : "98.31",
    Currency : "EUR",
    ItineraryCode: "08fe0a70b245acdad279c17904aaba873d1d9be3",
    Routes:
    [
     0  : [ // departure fights array
        0  : {AirportChange: false, MultipleAirlines: false, NextDayLanding: false, Ref: "0", Duration: "01:20",...},
        1  : {AirportChange: false, MultipleAirlines: false, NextDayLanding: false, Ref: "1", Duration: "01:20",...}
        2 : {AirportChange: false, MultipleAirlines: false, NextDayLanding: false, Ref: "3", Duration: "01:20",...}
    ],
     1 : [ // return flights array
       0 : {AirportChange: false, MultipleAirlines: true, NextDayLanding: false, Ref: "1", Duration: "03:20",..}
       1  : {AirportChange: false, MultipleAirlines: false, NextDayLanding: true, Ref: "0", Duration: "11:20",..}
    ]
    ]
:::
:::

#### What is a combination

A combination follows the format: `ab|cd`

-   **a = 0** - index of the departure flights array
    `_embedded.flights[0].Routes`
-   **b = {0, 1, 2}** - identifies the Route from departure flights
    array using the value of the Ref property
    `_embedded.flights[0].Routes[0].Route[0].Ref`
-   **c = 1** - index of the return flights array
    `_embedded.flights[0].Routes`
-   **d = {0, 1}** - identifies the route from return flights array
    using the value of the Ref property
    `_embedded.flights[0].Routes[1].Route[0].Ref`

#### Combination Examples

-   **00\|10:** you can go to your destination using the first route,
    but you will come back with the first route from return flights
-   **01\|11 or 02\|11:** you can go to your destination using the
    second or third route, but you will come back with the second route
    from return flights

Each route contains one (direct flight) or more segments (if the flight
has stopover). Also the route contains the operating and marketing
carrier and a price. The result body contains also data for filtering
the result, but the filters should be applied by you, not by using
another endpoint.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/v3/flights/:code/flight/:itinerarycode]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Validation Parameters

  Parameter                                  Type     Description                                                                                             Value
  ------------------------------------------ -------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------
  {\$Code}                                   string   The code that identifies the search                                                                     \-
  {\$itinerarycode}:{\$Combinations Index}   string   The code that identifies the flight concatenated with the id of chosen route from the array of routes   \-
:::

::: {.info-box}
::: {.info-box-content}
**Important Note:** If you have a \"itinerarycode is not valid!\"
warning, you probably forgot to add the route id at the end of
itinerarycode parameters or you do not have so many routes.
:::
:::

### Travel Fusion Offers {#travel-fusion-offers .no-number}

::: {.info-box}
::: {.info-box-content}
##### Auto-Ticketable Offers

The flight offers available from Travelfusion supplier are a one step
book & issue tickets offers. This means that once you make the
orders/{order}/method=book request, the tickets will be automatically
issued as well. These types of offers will always require that the order
is paid prior to making the book request.

The offers will have a specific flag on them **IsAutoTicketable** with
value true.
:::
:::

Upsell: Flight Branded Fares & Extra Services {#flights-branded-fares}
---------------------------------------------

### Get Upsell List - Branded Fares Packages

The flight itinerary that offers the upsell option will have the
property `UpsellSupport: true` in the flight results list (example:
`[0].UpsellSupport`)

The flight itinerary will also include the brand details of the price
available in the list. The details are available in the property:
`BrandedFare` (example: `[23].BrandedFare.BrandDetails[1]`)

To obtain the upsell options for a specific flight, you need to make a
specific request:

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get}
[/v3/flights/:code/flight/:itinerarycode/upsell]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Upsell Parameters

  Parameter                       Type     Description                                                                                             Value
  ------------------------------- -------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------
  {\$Code}                        string   The code that identifies the search                                                                     \-
  {\$itinerarycode}:{\$RouteId}   string   The code that identifies the flight concatenated with the id of chosen route from the array of routes   \-
:::

::: {.info-box}
::: {.info-box-content}
**Upsell Request Example:**\
`(GET) /v3/flights/AIR-WS-30da7c23e0b2b51e10b47ca8aa5c2e37/flight/beec788d85260523f605f757c21c7d38f0bab85b:0/upsell?`\
\
**AIR-WS-30da7c23e0b2b51e10b47ca8aa5c2e37** - Flight search results Code
(received in the search ID inspect request)\
**beec788d85260523f605f757c21c7d38f0bab85b:0** = Itinerary code +
combination index (received in the flight results request)\
\
This request will retrieve a list of packages with:\
• Price (`_embedded.upsell[0].Price.Amount`)\
• Services (`_embedded.upsell[0].FareDetails.BrandedFare.BrandDetails`)
:::
:::

### Upsell Item Characteristics

Each upsell item includes the `BrandDetails` which can have one or more
items, depending on how the information is available from the supplier.
In most cases, it includes an item per route. For example, for a round
trip search, it has 2 elements:

Each element will include:

-   **From & To elements** which indicates the airport codes for the
    route
-   **Services** -- On each route you will find the services list. Each
    service has certain properties that might be different based on the
    input of the airline.

#### ChargeType Property

The main property is `ChargeType` which indicates if:

-   **ChargeType: \"included\"** - The service is offered and included
    in the price.
-   **ChargeType: \"notOffered\"** -- The service is not available for
    this flight and it will not be available for purchase.
-   **ChargeType: \"chargeable\"** -- It\'s not included in the price
    but it can be purchased as an ancillary service.

#### Service Categories

Another relevant property for the service is the `Category`. Each
airline can offer a variation of categories and services, nonetheless we
have gathered a list of possible categories:

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Service Category Codes

  Code   Description
  ------ -----------------------
  CY     Carry on hand baggage
  BG     Baggage
  ML     Meal beverage
  SE     Seat
  VC     Voluntary change
  VR     Voluntary refund
  IE     Flight entertainment
  GT     Ground transport
  TS     Travel service
  FF     Frequent flyer
  LG     Lounge
  UP     Upgrades
  ST     Store
  MD     Medical
  BF     Other
:::

The `name` indicates the exact characteristics of the service and what
it includes.

### Validate a flight with a branded fare/upsell

When customer chooses one of the upsell offers, the flight validation
request must include also the branded fare code, as following:

::: {.info-box}
::: {.info-box-content}
**Branded Fare Validation Example:**\
`(GET) /v3/flights/AIR-WS-30da7c23e0b2b51e10b47ca8aa5c2e37/flight/beec788d85260523f605f757c21c7d38f0bab85b:0/K,K,K,K:[LIGHT,ROM,BER,LX,1-2][LIGHT,BER,ROM,LH,3-4]`\
\
**AIR-WS-30da7c23e0b2b51e10b47ca8aa5c2e37** - Flight search results Code
(received in the search ID inspect request)\
**beec788d85260523f605f757c21c7d38f0bab85b:0** - Itinerary code +
combination index (received in the flight results request)\
**K,K,K,K:\[LIGHT,ROM,BER,LX,1-2\]\[LIGHT,BER,ROM,LH,3-4\]** -- branded
fare code, available in the Upsell response (`_embedded.upsell[1].Code`)
:::
:::

The response received for the validation response will also include the
information about the services included in the fare selected
`FareDetails.BrandedFare.BrandDetails[0].Services`

### Book a flight with a branded fare/upsell

In the booking process, if a specific branded fare/upsell was selected,
the code of the upsell must be included when adding the flight service
on the order:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Booking with Upsell Code
:::

::: {.code-content}
    services[flight][0][upsellCode]: K,H,H,K:[STANDARD4,PAR,LAX,KL,1-2][STANDARD4,LAX,PAR,KL,3-4]
:::
:::

Flight Ancillary Services {#flights-optional-services}
-------------------------

Ancillary services are additional services that can be purchased
alongside flight tickets. These services enhance the travel experience
and provide passengers with customization options for their journey.

### Optional Services

Optional services are the most commonly encountered ancillary services.
Ancillaries will also come with services included in the price selected.
They might be the same as the ones received in the branded fares details
(not always - depends on the supplier). The service category code is the
same for branded fares as well as the services received as ancillaries
(included)

In the flight validation response, extra optional services can be
available.

The extra services that can be selected for book are found in the
validation response, in the Optional services section (OptionalServices)

Depending on the supplier and airline, the services might be available
per segment, per route or event per the entire flight (round trip,
example: From: CDG- To: CDG). In some cases, the supplier can provide
the same services per route/segment and per the entire itinerary at the
same time, so it\`s common to encounter a list of the same services per
segment and per itinerary in the same validation response. To determine
where the service is available, you need to check the values from
OptionalServices.OptionalService\[0\].Route.From and
OptionalServices.OptionalService\[0\].Route.To . Here you will find the
airport code.

The services might be different based on the passenger type, so the
value of the property \"target\" will highlight for which type of
passenger the service can be booked:
OptionalServices.OptionalService\[0\].Target: ADT/CHD/INF

There are 3 main types of services received in the response:

-   **Services included**
    (OptionalServices.OptionalService\[0\].Included:true) -- These are
    services included already in the flight selected.
-   **Services that cannot be booked and are not included**
    (OptionalServices.OptionalService\[0\].Included: false/null +
    OptionalServices.OptionalService\[7\].Options.Option\[0\].Price:
    null or not available
-   **Services that the customer can buy**
    OptionalServices.OptionalService\[0\].Included: false/null +
    OptionalServices.OptionalService\[7\].Options.Option\[0\].Price:

These ones are the services from which the customer can choose to add to
the flight.

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Optional Service Properties

  Property                   Type      Description
  -------------------------- --------- -----------------------------------------------------
  BookingCode                string    Unique identifier for the mandatory service booking
  Included                   boolean   Whether the service is included in the base price
  Route.From                 string    Departure airport code for the service
  Route.To                   string    Arrival airport code for the service
  Target                     string    Passenger type (ADT/CHD/INF)
  PassengerIndex             string    Index of the specific passenger (0-based)
  Service.CategoryCode       string    Service category identifier (e.g., ML for meals)
  Options.Option\[\].Code    string    Unique code for the specific option
  Options.Option\[\].Price   object    Price information including amount and currency
:::

#### Mandatory Services

In addition to optional services, some flights may have mandatory
services that passengers must select. These are services that are
required by the airline but allow passengers to choose from different
options.

Mandatory services are found in the validation response under the
\"MandatoryServices\" section and have the following characteristics:

##### Mandatory Service Structure

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Mandatory Service Example
:::

::: {.code-content}
    "MandatoryServices": {
        "MandatoryService": [
            {
                "BookingCode": "880f8779-fedd-5dd6-a316-89c348a73370",
                "Included": false,
                "Route": {
                    "From": "SHJ",
                    "To": "SAW"
                },
                "Target": "ADT",
                "PassengerIndex": "0",
                "Service": {
                    "Name": "Please Select a Meal Type",
                    "AtpcoGroup": "ML",
                    "AtpcoSubGroup": null,
                    "AtpcoCode": null,
                    "ChargeType": null,
                    "CategoryCode": "ML",
                    "CategoryName": "meal beverage"
                },
                "Options": {
                    "Option": [
                        {
                            "Description": "Butter Chicken 285(0 AED)",
                            "Code": "285-BUTERC",
                            "Selected": false,
                            "Price": {
                                "Amount": 0,
                                "Currency": "EUR"
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "Status": null
            }
        ]
    }
:::
:::

#### Validate the flight with services

::: {.info-box .warning}
::: {.info-box-content}
**Important:** When booking flights with ancillary services, you must
include the selected options in an extra validation request and in the
order request using the BookingCode and the selected Option Code.
:::
:::

Before you proceed to the booking process, first you need to validate
and check if the services are still available and if the price is still
the one received in the initial validation. In order to do that, you
need to make a POST request to
/v3/flights/AIR-WS-072e542274719eb17a4d75e1789e2c81/flight?

With the following data

-   itineraryCode: ItineraryCode
-   optionalServices\[0\]\[bookingCode\]:OptionalServices.OptionalService\[21\].BookingCode
-   optionalServices\[0\]\[selectedOptionCode\]:
    OptionalServices.OptionalService\[21\].Options.Option\[0\].Cod
-   mandatoryServices\[0\]\[bookingCode\]:
    MandatoryServices.MandatoryService\[0\].BookingCode
-   mandatoryServices\[0\]\[selectedOptionCode\]:
    MandatoryServices.MandatoryService\[0\].Options.Option\[0\].Code

::: {.endpoint}
[POST]{.method .post} [v3/flights/\[ResultCode\]/flight]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description                           Type     Parameter        Value
  ------------------------------------- -------- ---------------- -------
  The code that identifies the search   string   {\$ResultCode}   

#### POST Parameters

  Description                                                                                             Type     Parameter                                      Value
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------- ---------------------------------------------- ------------
  The code that identifies the flight concatenated with the id of chosed route from the array of routes   string   {\$itinerarycode}:{\$RouteId}                  
  Booking code of the service                                                                                      mandatoryServices\[0\]\[bookingCode\]          1754575390
  Selected option code                                                                                             mandatoryServices\[0\]\[selectedOptionCode\]   1754575390
:::

#### Book

After the validation, check the price and display the final price to the
customer.The next step is to make the order, add services to order and
make the booking. Make sure that you use the price from the final
validation when you add the data on the order.

Get Paid Seats & Seat Map {#flights-paid-seats}
-------------------------

### Seat location preference (W or A)

Some airlines might not provide paid seats or the customer\'s preference
is only Window (W) or Aisle (A) seat. In this case, the services data
added on order must be added in the following way per each segment on
which you want to add the preference selection:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Seat Preference Format
:::

    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_0:PREFERENCE]:A
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_0:ORIGIN]: LHR
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_0:DESTINATION]: CDG
:::

**Where:**

-   **\[ADT\]** -- Type of passenger
-   **\[0\]** -- Passenger index (make sure it\'s the same index you are
    using when sending the passenger data)
-   **\[SEAT:ROUTE\_0\_0:PREFERENCE\]** - first value (\_0) is the route
    index and second one is the segment index (\_0)
-   Flight validation response example -- Route index identification
-   Flight validation response example -- Segment index identification
-   **A** -- The value represents the location preference (A or W are
    the only possible values)
-   **\[SEAT:ROUTE\_0\_0:ORIGIN\]: LHR** -- Departure (origin) Airport
    code for route index 0 segment index 0
-   **\[SEAT:ROUTE\_0\_0:DESTINATION\]** -- Destination Airport code for
    route index 0 segment index 0

The preference is sent to the GDS, but the seat location cannot be
guaranteed.

### Buy seat - Get seat map

Flight seat map might be available from some suppliers.

To know if seat map is available, an extra request must be made.

Along with the seat map, the paid seats will be retrieved as well.

Seats without charge might be retrieved when requesting the seat map for
paid seats, those must be sent as preference on the order (as explained
above).

In case a branded fare (upsell item) is selected as well, the code of
the Upsell must be included in the seat map request.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get}
[/v3/flights/:flights\_code/flight/:flight\_itinerary\_code/seats/:ocode/:dcode/:route\_index/:request\_paid\_seats?upsellCode={upsellCode}]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Seat Map Parameters

  Description                                                                                             Type     Parameter                Value
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------- ------------------------ ------------------------------------------
  The code that identifies the search                                                                     string   {\$Code}                 
  The code that identifies the flight concatenated with the id of chosen route from the array of routes   string   {\$itinerarycode}        
  Segment Origin Airport code                                                                             string   {\$ocode}                
  Segment Destination Airport code                                                                        string   {\$dcode}                
  Route index                                                                                             string   {Route index}            0
  Request paid seats (1 - all including paid; 0 - only seat map without prices)                           string   {request\_paid\_seats}   1
  Upsell code                                                                                             string   {upsellCode}             4287ca658db6734f920162a7cc99a113972f5a85
:::

### Understanding Seat Map Response

The seat map response provides all the data needed to build an
interactive aircraft seating chart and handle seat selection. This
section explains how to interpret and use this data.

#### 1. Building the Aircraft Layout

The seat map uses **Columns** and **Rows** to define the aircraft
structure. Each column represents a vertical line of seats (A, B, C,
etc.) and each row represents a horizontal line (1, 2, 3, etc.).

##### Column Position Properties

Each column has two key properties that determine seat positioning:

::: {.parameters-table}
  Property         Value            Seat Type         Example
  ---------------- ---------------- ----------------- --------------------------------
  `Window: true`   `Aisle: null`    **Window Seat**   Columns A, F in typical layout
  `Aisle: true`    `Window: null`   **Aisle Seat**    Columns C, D in typical layout
  `Window: null`   `Aisle: null`    **Middle Seat**   Columns B, E in typical layout
:::

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Typical Aircraft Layout Example
:::

    // Typical 3-3 aircraft configuration
    Row 12: [A] [B] [C]  ---- AISLE ----  [D] [E] [F]
            WIN MID AIS                    AIS MID WIN

    // Column properties:
    Column A: { Window: true,  Aisle: null }  // Window seat
    Column B: { Window: null,  Aisle: null }  // Middle seat
    Column C: { Window: null,  Aisle: true }  // Aisle seat
    Column D: { Window: null,  Aisle: true }  // Aisle seat
    Column E: { Window: null,  Aisle: null }  // Middle seat
    Column F: { Window: true,  Aisle: null }  // Window seat

    // The aisle/lane is placed between columns C and D
:::

#### 2. Seat Availability and Pricing

Each individual seat has properties that determine if it can be selected
and whether it costs extra.

##### Seat Availability Rules

The `Available` property determines if a seat can be selected:

::: {.parameters-table}
  Available   ChargeTypeReference   Result                                 How to Book
  ----------- --------------------- -------------------------------------- ------------------------
  `true`      Not present           **Free seat** - available at no cost   Send as **preference**
  `true`      Present               **Paid seat** - available for a fee    Send as **paid seat**
  `false`     Any                   **Unavailable** - cannot be selected   Do not allow selection
:::

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Seat Availability Examples
:::

    // Free seat - send as preference
    {
      "Available": true,
      "Number": "12",
      "Code": "A"
      // No ChargeTypeReference = FREE
    }

    // Paid seat - send as paid seat
    {
      "Available": true,
      "Number": "12",
      "Code": "B",
      "ChargeTypeReference": "CT001"  // Has charge = PAID
    }

    // Unavailable seat - cannot select
    {
      "Available": false,
      "Number": "12",
      "Code": "C"
    }
:::

#### 3. Individual Seat Properties

Each seat in the map has additional properties that affect display and
selection:

::: {.parameters-table}
##### Basic Seat Information

  Property                Purpose                                       Example Value
  ----------------------- --------------------------------------------- -----------------------------
  `Code`                  Column identifier (A, B, C, etc.)             \"A\", \"B\", \"C\"
  `Number`                Row number for the seat                       \"12\", \"15\", \"23\"
  `ChargeTypeReference`   Links to pricing information for paid seats   \"CT001\", \"PREMIUM\_001\"
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
##### Special Seat Indicators

  Property             When Present                                      Display Recommendation
  -------------------- ------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  `HandicapFriendly`   Seat accommodates accessibility needs             Show accessibility icon, highlight for customers with special needs
  `NoSeat`             No physical seat exists at this position          Show as empty space or blocked area
  `Preferential`       Reserved for premium passengers/frequent flyers   Mark as \"preferred seating\" - may be reassigned if customer ineligible
:::

#### 4. Finding Seat Prices

For paid seats, you need to match the seat\'s `ChargeTypeReference` with
the pricing information in `ChargeList`:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Step-by-Step: Getting Seat Price
:::

    // Step 1: Check if seat has a charge reference
    const seat = SeatMap.Rows.Row[6].Seat[0];
    if (seat.ChargeTypeReference) {

        // Step 2: Find matching charge type in ChargeList
        const chargeRef = seat.ChargeTypeReference; // e.g., "CT001"
        const chargeType = SeatMap.ChargeList.ChargeType.find(
            ct => ct.Reference === chargeRef
        );

        // Step 3: Get the price
        const price = chargeType.Price.Amount;     // e.g., 25.00
        const currency = chargeType.Price.Currency; // e.g., "EUR"

        console.log(`Seat ${seat.Number}${seat.Code} costs ${price} ${currency}`);
        // Output: "Seat 12A costs 25.00 EUR"
    }
:::

#### 5. Quick Reference Summary

::: {.parameters-table}
  Seat Scenario     Properties                                     Action
  ----------------- ---------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------
  **Free Seat**     `Available: true`, no `ChargeTypeReference`    Allow selection, book as preference
  **Paid Seat**     `Available: true`, has `ChargeTypeReference`   Show price, book as paid seat
  **Unavailable**   `Available: false`                             Disable selection, show as occupied/blocked
  **No Seat**       `NoSeat: true`                                 Show as empty space in layout
:::

### Book with seat preference

#### Example with one segment per route

preference

#### Example with 2 segments per route (stopover)

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Seat Preference Booking - Two Segments Per Route
:::

    owner[city]: unnecessary
    owner[street]: unnecessary
    owner[housenr]: 00000
    owner[zipcode]: 00000
    owner[country]: --
    owner[email]: Test.Test@dcsplus.net
    owner[firstname]: John
    owner[lastname]: Doe
    owner[phone]: 32233223
    owner[title]: Mr
    details[lowFare]: 1418
    details[fullFare]: 8865
    details[travelPolicyName]: guest
    details[outsideReasons]: price
    details[outsidePriceAmount]: 10.00
    flight[payment]: credit
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_0:PREFERENCE]: W
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_0:ORIGIN]: LHR
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_0:DESTINATION]: YVR
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_1:PREFERENCE]: A
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_1:ORIGIN]: YVR

### Seat without charge - preference

If the customer chooses a seat with no chargeable type property, meaning
that the seat can be selected as a preference only, the request data
must be sent in the following way:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Seat Without Charge Format
:::

    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_1:ORIGIN]: YVR
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_1:DESTINATION]: LAX
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_1:NUMBER]: 22
    services[flight][0][passenger][ADT][0][details][SEAT:ROUTE_0_1:CODE]: D
:::

**\[SEAT:ROUTE\_0\_1:NUMBER\]:** The value must be taken from the seat
map response, seat number (SeatMap.Rows.Row\[1\].Seat\[0\].Number)

**\[SEAT:ROUTE\_0\_1:CODE\]:** The value must be taken from the seat map
response, code of the seat (SeatMap.Rows.Row\[1\].Seat\[0\].Code)

### Book with paid seat

Make sure that before book you validate the flight with the seat
selection and display the price to the customer according to the latest
validation request.

Also, use the booking the amount of the latest validation request made.

Adding a paid seat on the reservation, means that you also reserve that
specific seat. Whenever you add a paid seat in the request, the format
of the data must be the following:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Paid Seat Format
:::

    services[flight][0][paidSeats][0][passengerIndex]: 0
    services[flight][0][paidSeats][0][segmentIndex]: 0
    services[flight][0][paidSeats][0][legIndex]: 0
    services[flight][0][paidSeats][0][seatColumn]: D
    services[flight][0][paidSeats][0][seatNumber]: 7
    services[flight][0][paidSeats][0][amount]: 12
    services[flight][0][paidSeats][0][currency]: EUR
:::

**Where:**

-   **\[legIndex\]** - Route index
-   **\[amount\]** - Amount per seat must be added according to the
    Charge type assigned to the seat selected. The price is found in the
    seat map response, in:
    SeatMap.ChargeList.ChargeType\[0\].Price.Amount

#### Example with 2 segments per route

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Paid Seat Booking - Two Segments Per Route
:::

    owner[city]: unnecessary
    owner[street]: unnecessary
    owner[housenr]: 00000
    owner[zipcode]: 00000
    owner[country]: --
    owner[email]: Test.Test@dcsplus.net
    owner[firstname]: Test c a
    owner[lastname]: Test

Flight Orders {#flights-orders}
-------------

[Go to Orders section](#orders-create) to see how the order is created,
how the service data is added, and what are the particularities of the
service.

As for any other TRIP order, the flow for creating a flight order is the
same as for any other order.

### Order Process

1.  **Validate Flight:** Confirm availability and pricing
2.  **Create Order:** Initialize the booking
3.  **Payment:** Process payment. Tickets are issued automatically if
    the flow doesn\`t require payment to supplier.
4.  **Confirmation:** Receive booking confirmation
5.  **Ticketing:** Issue methods request & Issued tickets request in
    case Issue process requires payment to supplier [Flight Issue
    Process - Payment to Supplier](#flight-issue-process)

### Flight Order Example

::: {.endpoint}
[POST]{.method .post} [/orders]{.url}
:::

    services[flight][0][optionalServices][6][bookingCode]:1b697fc7-291a-58de-a1cd-35a09f84f2fe

    language:en
:::

::: {.info-box .info-box-warning style="margin-top: 1rem;"}
::: {.info-box-content}
##### Comments Field -- Character Limit

The `services[flight][0][comments]` field accepts free-text special
requests. The value is limited to **255 characters**. Submissions
exceeding this limit will be truncated.
:::
:::

</div>

::: {#hotels-service .section .content-section}
Hotels Service {#hotels-service-title}
==============

### Hotel Search & Book Process

1.  [**Search Hotels:** Find available hotels](#hotels-search)
2.  [**Select Hotel:** Choose preferred hotel and room
    type](#hotels-search)
3.  [**Validate Offer:** Confirm availability and
    pricing](#hotels-select-rooms)
4.  [**Create Order:** Initialize the order process\
    Add Guest & Offer Details\
    Select Extra Services if any](#hotels-orders)
5.  [**Payment:** Process payment](#payment-general)
6.  [**Confirmation:** Receive booking
    confirmation](#orders-get-specific)

Top Hotels {#hotels-top}
----------

This module allows you to select from TRIP\'s admin area some hotels
(per city) and rank them based on your priority.

After making the admin configurations you can obtain the list of
configured hotels per city and you can use that list however you need
it.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/hotel-rating/hotels]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description                                                                                                              Type   Parameter   Value
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ------ ----------- -------
  Id of the searched city                                                                                                  int    cityId      
  Or                                                                                                                                          
  Id of the searched region (TRIP will retrieve all the top hotels configured on the cities included in that IRIX region   int    regionId    
:::

The request will return a list of hotels with the hotel ID (that you can
match with your search results) and other useful details like
ranking/rating or hotel name.

Hotel Search {#hotels-search}
------------

As it was explained on the Search Process page, to perform a search on
different services, you have to define a container by choosing a
container id, then you can add different services, \"h\" for hotel in
our case, in the container and make the search request.

When you make a search request, you\'re looking for a package that may
include multiple rooms. For example, you can search for a hotel with one
room for two adults and one child, and another room for one adult and
two children, all in the same request. Once you submit the request,
you\'ll receive a list of hotels that have these room types available.
From there, you can select the specific room package you want.

**It\`s mandatory to search by: City ID or City Codeor Region Id or
Hotel ID or coordinates (lng;lat). You cannot search by all of them or
more than one at once!**

::: {.endpoint}
[POST]{.method .post} [/dynamic-package]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Hotel Search Parameters

Description
:::
:::

Type

Parameter

Value

Check-in date

date

\_s\[ContainerId\]\[h\]\[0\]\[dIn\]

2025-07-25

Check-out date

date

\_s\[ContainerId\]\[h\]\[0\]\[dOut\]

2025-07-26

\_s\[ContainerId\]\[h\]\[0\]\[cityId\]

1

PAR

string

\_s\[ContainerId\]\[h\]\[0\]\[regId\]

2

int

\_s\[ContainerId\]\[h\]\[0\]\[hotel\]\[id\]

Provider Parameters --- supplier-specific additional parameters

Supplier-specific parameter passed to the provider. The key structure is
`[providerParameters][{supplier}][{paramName}]`. Multiple suppliers and
multiple parameters per supplier are supported.

string / int

\_s\[ContainerId\]\[h\]\[0\]\[providerParameters\]\[{supplier}\]\[{param}\]

see examples below

::: {.info-box .info}
::: {.info-box-content}
#### Distance Calculation -- Search Request

When `poiLat` & `poiLng` are provided in the search request, distance is
calculated **exclusively** based on these values.

Any additional `lat`/`lng` parameters sent in the hotels list request
are ignored and are not required.
:::
:::

### Important Notes

Up to 5 rooms ca be searched at once.

-   **Nationality ID** -- TRIP has a back-up nationality that is sent in
    a search request, but the proper way to make a search is to add in
    the request the nationality of the passenger (lead passenger)
-   **Language** -- ISO code can be sent in the search request and you
    can receive multi language content (if the suppliers provide such
    content): \_s\[CID\]\[h\]\[0\]\[hotel\]\[lang\]: ro\_RO
-   **Children age** -- The ages should be specified relative to the
    check-in date and, when adding passenger data on the order, the
    birthdate must be valid for the specified age at check-in date. CHD
    = 2-18 (17 years -11 months -x days -- relative to month)\
    \
    **Example:**\
    For two children aged 4 and 7 and the check-in date on 2020-12-28:
    -   for the child with age 4, the birthdate should be between
        2015-12-29 and 2016-12-28
    -   for the child with age 7, the birthdate should be between
        2012-12-29 and 2013-12-28

    ::: {.info-box .warning}
    ::: {.info-box-content}
    If a search occupancy includes 2 children with different ages, the
    order in which children are added on the order is not necesarly the
    same as it was in the search request. This depends on the supplier.
    The order in which the data must be collected and added on the order
    is specified in the room validation response. The
    **PackageRooms.PackageRoom\[0\].Occupancy.ChildAge** will retreive
    the age and order of each occupant in each room.
    :::
    :::

### Cancellation Deadline in Rooms List

The **Cancellation Deadline** can be included in the rooms list response
by adding the parameter `_s[ContainerId][h][0][cancellationDeadline]: 1`
to the search request.

When enabled, the cancellation deadline is returned per room, allowing
you to display free cancellation periods or highlight time-sensitive
offers directly in the room list.

### Hotel Search Provider Parameters {#hotels-provider-parameters}

Some suppliers may require or support additional functionalities through
custom parameters. TRIP supports passing these parameters in the search
request using the `providerParameters` structure.

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Provider Parameters -- Example
:::

    _s[Develop][h][0][providerParameters][expediarapid][sales_channel]: test
    _s[Develop][h][0][providerParameters][expediarapid][test_property]: 1

    _s[Develop][h][0][providerParameters][othersupplier][test_property]: 2
:::

::: {.info-box .warning}
::: {.info-box-content}
####  Important

Provider parameters are **supplier-specific** and may vary depending on
the integration. Make sure to:

-   Consult your supplier documentation
-   Coordinate with your **TRIP Project Manager**

to determine the correct parameters and values required for your
implementation.
:::
:::

::: {.info-box .info}
::: {.info-box-content}
####  Application-Level Configuration

These parameters can also be configured at the **application level** if
they do not need to be changed dynamically. If a parameter must be
included in all search requests, you can configure it globally --- no
need to send it on every request.

For more details and setup assistance, please contact your **TRIP
Project Manager**.
:::
:::

Get Search Result Code/Inspect SID {#hotels-get-search-code}
----------------------------------

This request it is used to obtain the search code (same as any other
serach ).

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/en/dynamic-package/sid/:id]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description                                    Type     Parameter   Value
  ---------------------------------------------- -------- ----------- -------
  The id received in a search request response   string   {\$Id}      
:::

The response body contain the search request parameters and a code. This
code will be used to get the response of the search request.

Life property on the response indicates current remaining lifetime in
seconds, meaning in how much time the results for this code will expire.

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Search Result Code Response Example
:::

    {
        "dIn": "2025-09-12",
        "dOut": "2025-09-24",
        "cityId": "10",
        "countryName": "United Kingdom",
        "countryId": "7",
        "onRq": "0",
        "r": [
            {
                "adt": "1"
            }
        ],
        "hotel": {
            "lang": "en_GB",
            "stars": "0+"
        },
        "cityName": "LONDON",
        "nat": "4",
        "code": "a9f0389a-ec57-44d2-b496-c05823369e43",
        "updated": 1755006306,
        "life": 1798
    }
:::

Obtain The Hotels Search List {#hotels-get-list}
-----------------------------

The hotel search request is asynchronous. That means you can receive
partial responses, until the search is complete. To obtain it, there is
an extra parameter that needs to be added in the request summary=true .
In the response body a message will be displayed indicating that the
search is running.

You need to make multiple requests until the summary progress is 100 and
all results can be provided (which means that the search is completed).

Once the search summary reaches 100%, make a hotels list request without
the summary parameter to receive the final list with all the necessary
data. **Making the final request without the summary parameter will
bring extra information on the list, like the image of the hotel.**

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/v3/hotels]{.url}
:::

#### Parameters - Get search status

::: {.parameters-table}
  Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Type     Parameter   Value
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------- ----------- ---------------------
  A code that identifies the results list                                                                                                                                                                                                              string   {\$Code}    
  A parameter use to make asynchronous hotel search                                                                                                                                                                                                    bool     summary     empty string / True
  Includes hotel image in the summary response. Image retrieval is **not included by default** --- must be enabled upon request.                                                                                                                       bool     image       true
  Reference point latitude for distance calculation (venue/POI). Used when `poiLat` was not provided in the search request. **Should be sent only in the final request (after 100% progress) --- distance is not returned during summary polling.**    float    lat         
  Reference point longitude for distance calculation (venue/POI). Used when `poiLng` was not provided in the search request. **Should be sent only in the final request (after 100% progress) --- distance is not returned during summary polling.**   float    lng         
:::

::: {.info-box .info}
::: {.info-box-content}
#### Distance Calculation -- Hotels List Request

If `poiLat` & `poiLng` were **not** provided in the search request,
distance can be calculated by sending a `lat`/`lng` pair in the hotels
list request.

-   **Distance is only retrieved after the search reaches 100%
    progress.** It is not returned in partial (summary polling)
    responses.
-   The `lat`/`lng` parameters should be sent in the **final request**
    --- the one made after 100% and without the `summary` parameter.
-   These coordinates represent the reference point (venue/POI) for
    distance calculation.
-   Distance is updated dynamically whenever the coordinates change.
-   This approach is useful when a dynamic change of the reference point
    (POI) is required, but it may have an impact on response time.
:::
:::

::: {.info-box .warning}
::: {.info-box-content}
####  Performance Consideration -- Images with `summary=true`

The `summary=true` parameter is designed to return results as fast as
possible, with minimal data.

-   Adding `image=true` alongside `summary=true` enables hotel images in
    the partial (pre-100%) response.
-   Image retrieval is **not included by default** and can be enabled
    upon request.
-   Including images may slightly increase response time compared to a
    summary-only request.
:::
:::

::: {.code-example .collapsed}
::: {.code-header}
Search Result Code Response Example
:::

::: {.code-content}
    {
        "summary": {
            "sid": "d1858620c78e8c2bba537d5da7541f0c",
            "progress": 82.04,
            "resultCode": "82f92800-751b-4348-aaf3-6a74bea7ba5b",
            "offers": 2,
            "systems": {
                "1AHotels": 100,
                "expediarapid": 76,
                "hotelbeds": 100
            },
            "count": 2
        },
        "page": "1",
        "page_count": 1,
        "page_size": "9999",

            "self": {
                "href": "/index.php\/v3\/hotels?code=82f92800-751b-4348-aaf3-6a74bea7ba5b"
            }
        },
        "_embedded": {
            "hotels": [
                {
                    "Id": 41463,

:::
:::

-   **summary.progress** - this will be 100 when the search is
    completed;
-   **summary.systems.{supplierName}** - this will indicate the progress
    of the search per supplier;
-   **count** - number of hotels;

#### Parameters - Get search full

Once the summary reaches 100%, make a hotels list request without the
summary parameter to receive the final list with all the necessary data.

-   The request retrieves all results

-   Available information:**Hotel Name, Hotel Image Link, Hotel ID, Min
    Price, Stars.**

    Some suppliers can offer an extra attribute **RateTags** . The most
    common attribute is negotiated fares, which are preferential prices
    dedicated to a specific agency. Now the attribute is available also
    in the Hotels list, so if one room includes at least one Rate
    plan/tag, the information will be available on the hotels list as

-   There are extra details that can be available on the hotels list if
    extra parameters are added in the request.

#### Extra Information on the List

The extra information can be obtained by adding extra parameters in the
list request:

-   **Facilities:** To obtain facilities for each hotel, add the
    parameter part\[\] = Facilities in the last hotels list request (the
    one without summary=true).
-   **Hotel short description:** To obtain the short description for
    each hotel, add the parameter part\[\] = ShortDec in the last hotels
    list request (the one without summary=true).
-   **Points of Interest :**\
    The property is called **Pois** (points of interest) and it
    retrieves a list of locations near a hotel (in a radius of 5
    kilometers).\
    \
    That information can be used for multiple purposes, either to
    showcase locations near a hotel or even allow your users to filter
    hotels based on a certain location. For example, users can see only
    the hotels near the city center or even a known attraction.\
    \
    The points of interest are imported in TRIP from IRIX Locations. In
    case you already use dcs plus\'s mapping service, the locations will
    be provided. If you are not using our mapping service, you can
    enrich the content in IRIX by adding manually the locations in the
    IRIX admin area/Mapping/Locations. Make sure to add valid
    coordinates as this is the main processing factor in linking a
    location to a hotel.\
    \
    **Setup details:**\
    To receive the information, you just need to make sure the
    synchronization was done between IRIX and TRIP for locations and to
    add an extra parameter in your hotel\'s list request.\
    \
    ::: {.parameters-table}
      Description                                                                      Type     Parameter         Value
      -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------- ----------------- -------
      A parameter use to receive Facilities in the list response                       string   part=Facilities   
      A parameter use to receive Points of inetrest (locations) in the list response   string   part=Pois         
      A parameter use to receive Hotel short description in the list response          string   part=ShortDesc    
    :::

    ::: {.info-box .info}
    ::: {.info-box-content}
    **Retrieving Additional Information Using the part Parameter**To
    retrieve additional data when listing results, ensure the part
    parameter includes all the required values. The correct format is:

         part=ShortDesc,Pois,Facilities 

    This syntax will include the short description, points of interest
    (Pois), and facilities information in the response.
    :::
    :::

    **Response example:**\
    ::: {.code-example}
    ::: {.code-header}

    :::

    ::: {.code-content}

    \

#### One Room Search - Extra Details

-   **Board Basis:** Available under hotel filters, hotel items, and
    room items as BoardBasis. It must be included when creating an
    order.\
    Example: services\[hotel\]\[0\]\[room\]\[0\]\[boardBasis\]: RO
-   **Available Values for Board Basis:**
    -   RO - Room Only
    -   SC - Self Catering
    -   BB - Bed and Breakfast
    -   HB - Half Board
    -   FB - Full Board
    -   AI - All Inclusive
    -   RD - See room description (cannot be determined)
-   **Refundable & Non-Refundable:** Indicated in hotel filters, hotel
    items, and room items.

### Multi-Language Content

-   Search requests include a language parameter (selected by the user
    from the admin area/languages).
-   When requesting hotel details, IRIX retrieves rooms based on the
    search, while TRIP fetches static details (description, facilities,
    location, etc.) in the selected language.
-   If no static data is available in the specified language, TRIP will
    display the default stored information.

#### Search, Description & Validation Requests with Language

-   In all the hotel requests, add in the request headers the parameter
    X-Lang:{two letters language code}
-   For the first search request (/dynamic-package), add the POST
    parameter: \_s\[CID\]\[h\]\[0\]\[hotel\]\[lang\]: {iso code: en\_EN}
    (ISO language code).
-   The language code must be configured in TRIP\'s admin area and
    available in IRIX.
-   For hotel details, use the GET request format:
    /v3/hotels/{hotelID}?lang=en\_EN

Hotel Details {#hotels-details}
-------------

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/v3/hotels/:id?lang=en\_EN]{.url}
:::

::: {.info-box}
::: {.info-box-content}
TRIP detects if a hotel in the results is missing from the static
database and sends a synchronization request between the IRIX database
and TRIP.
:::
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description                                     Type     Parameter   Value
  ----------------------------------------------- -------- ----------- -------
  Hotel Id, which identifies the hotel uniquely   string   Id          
  Language (optional)                             string   lang        
:::

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}

Get hotel rooms list {#hotels-room-packages}
--------------------

Now we need to see the hotel room packages list(available offers for a
hotel). This request will give this informations.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/v2/hotels/:code/:hotelid/package]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description                                Type     Parameter   Value
  ------------------------------------------ -------- ----------- -------
  A code that identifies the results list.   string   :code       
  An id that identifies the hotel.           int      :hotelid    
:::

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}

Every package is identified by a PackageCode and has a Price, an Amount
and a list of PackageRooms, this being the rooms required at search and
for every room we have one or more choices under the key RoomRefs.

The RoomRef array will always contain at least one option (this
difference comes from the type of supplier connected):

-   **One room per package.** This usually is the list version , where
    the package price is the room price (or rooms price if the search is
    for more than one room).
-   **Selector rooms/multiple options under the same package.** This
    usually is available as a selector and the package price is only
    reflecting the value of the first room from the selector/ the room
    which has the flag Selected: True. In this situation, when the user
    selects a room for which the fla is False, you need to make the
    validation request (Select rooms for a package).

::: {.info-box .warning}
::: {.info-box-content}
##### Offer price

Always use the offer price \_embedded.packages\[0\].Price.Amount - This
is the price that includes mark-ups or service fees. In some cases, you
might see price at room level, but that information is not always
available from the suppliers and it is not reliable.
:::
:::

Select rooms for a package/ Validate offer {#hotels-select-rooms}
------------------------------------------

For every room we required (from the specific package obtained in the
last request) we have to select a room from RoomRef array. To select
this room you have to send a special parameter roomsCombination. The
parameters has the following form:
FirstPackageRoomCode:FirstSelectedRoomCode-SecondPackageRoomCode:SecondSelectedRoomCode-ThirdPackageRoomCode:ThirdSelectedRoomCode-\...

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get}
[/v2/hotels/:resultCode/:hotelId/package/:packageCode/:roomscombination]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description                                                     Type     Parameter           Value
  --------------------------------------------------------------- -------- ------------------- -------
  A code that identifies the results list.                        string   :resultcode         
  An id that identifies the hotel.                                string   :hotelid            
  A code that identifies a package from the list of packages.     string   :packagecode        
  A combination that identifies the rooms choosed to be booked.   string   :roomscombination   
:::

### How to Construct Room Combination Requests

The roomsCombination parameter is crucial for selecting specific rooms
from the available options. This section explains how to construct the
proper room combination string using data from the Hotel Package search
responses.

#### Understanding the Room Combination Format

The roomsCombination parameter follows this pattern:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Room Combination Format
:::

    PackageRoomCode1:SelectedRoomCode1-PackageRoomCode2:SelectedRoomCode2-PackageRoomCode3:SelectedRoomCode3
:::

#### Example 1: Single Room Selection

Based on the 1 room search example, if you want to select a specific
room option:

::: {.step-subsection}
##### From the Search Response:

-   **PackageCode:** \"0c198c7e6c376ed21060cdfb5b44b98d\_0\"
-   **PackageRoomCode:** \"0\" (from
    PackageRooms.PackageRoom\[0\].PackageRoomCode)
-   **Available Room Options:**
    -   RoomCode \"0\": \"9-BED MIXED WITH WITH EXTERNAL SHARED
        BATHROOM\" (Selected: true)
    -   RoomCode \"1\": \"6-BED MIXED WITH WITH EXTERNAL SHARED
        BATHROOM\" (Selected: true)
    -   RoomCode \"2\": \"4-BED MIXED WITH WITH EXTERNAL SHARED
        BATHROOM\" (Selected: true)

##### Request Examples:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Select \"6-BED MIXED\" Room (RoomCode \"1\")
:::

    GET /v2/hotels/c24836cf-10f5-490e-8f28-8b6cfc4bfc1f/202904/package/0c198c7e6c376ed21060cdfb5b44b98d_0/0:1
:::

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Select \"4-BED MIXED\" Room (RoomCode \"2\")
:::

    GET /v2/hotels/c24836cf-10f5-490e-8f28-8b6cfc4bfc1f/202904/package/0c198c7e6c376ed21060cdfb5b44b98d_0/0:2
:::
:::

#### Example 2: Multiple Rooms Selection (3 Rooms)

Based on the 3 rooms search example, when you have multiple PackageRoom
entries:

::: {.step-subsection}
##### From the Search Response:

-   **PackageCode:** \"6256ed440431f864295beaca2327fd0a\_0\"
-   **PackageRoom 0 (Adults: 1, Children: 0):** PackageRoomCode \"0\"
    with room options:
    -   RoomCode \"0\": \"Superior Room with King Bed\" (Selected: true,
        Non-refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"8\": \"Superior room with Double Bed\" (Selected:
        false, Non-refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"16\": \"Executive Room\" (Selected: false,
        Non-refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"3\": \"Superior Room with King Bed\" (Selected:
        false, Bed & Breakfast)
-   **PackageRoom 1 (Adults: 2, Children: 2, Child Ages: 2, 14):**
    PackageRoomCode \"1\" with room options:
    -   RoomCode \"53\": \"Superior with queen beds- Capacity 4\"
        (Selected: true, Non-refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"55\": \"Superior with queen beds- Capacity 4\"
        (Selected: false, Non-refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"57\": \"Superior with queen beds- Capacity 4\"
        (Selected: false, Refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"59\": \"Superior with queen beds- Capacity 4\"
        (Selected: false, Refundable)
-   **PackageRoom 2 (Adults: 1, Children: 0):** PackageRoomCode \"2\"
    with room options:
    -   RoomCode \"0\": \"Superior Room with King Bed\" (Selected: true,
        Non-refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"8\": \"Superior room with Double Bed\" (Selected:
        false, Non-refundable)
    -   RoomCode \"1\": \"Superior Room with King Bed\" (Selected:
        false, Non-refundable)

##### Request Examples:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Select \"Superior Double Bed\" for Room 0, Default \"Queen Beds\" for
Room 1, Default \"King Bed\" for Room 2
:::

    GET /v2/hotels/79184425-fae7-437c-bd27-cd59538fd3d2/20589/package/6256ed440431f864295beaca2327fd0a_0/0:8-1:53-2:0
:::

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Select \"Executive Room\" for Room 0, Refundable \"Queen Beds\" for Room
1, \"Double Bed\" for Room 2
:::

    GET /v2/hotels/79184425-fae7-437c-bd27-cd59538fd3d2/20589/package/6256ed440431f864295beaca2327fd0a_0/0:16-1:57-2:8
:::

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Select \"Superior King Bed with Breakfast\" for Room 0, Higher Rate
\"Queen Beds\" for Room 1, Alternative \"King Bed\" for Room 2
:::

    GET /v2/hotels/79184425-fae7-437c-bd27-cd59538fd3d2/20589/package/6256ed440431f864295beaca2327fd0a_0/0:3-1:59-2:1
:::
:::

#### Key Points for Room Selection

::: {.info-box .warning}
::: {.info-box-content}
-   **Package-Level Pricing:** Important! Pricing is calculated at the
    package level, not per individual room. The total package price may
    change when you select different room combinations, even if
    individual rooms don\'t show prices.
-   **Selected vs Non-Selected:** In the search response, rooms with
    \"Selected\": true show the default selection and package pricing.
    To get pricing for rooms with \"Selected\": false, you must use this
    validation endpoint.
-   **Room Availability:** Only select rooms with \"Status\":
    \"OK\".Rooms with \"Status\": \"RQ\" (on request) can\`t be booked.
-   **Price Validation:** The validation request will return updated
    package pricing and availability for your specific room combination.
-   **Order Matters:** The order of PackageRoomCode:RoomCode pairs
    should match the order of PackageRoom entries in the search
    response.
:::
:::

#### Room details.

Depending on the supplier you have connected, there might be extra
details available per room. The extra details can be:

1.  Gallery of images
2.  Room facilitie
3.  Room description
4.  Rate rate details
5.  Taxes
6.  Mandatory extra information per passenger (check Offer
    configuration)

::: {.parameters-table}

Example: 12901
:::

Extra services {#hotels-extra-services}
--------------

The extra services for a hotel are available in the room validation
response, per room:

Example:
PackageRooms.PackageRoom\[0\].RoomRefs.RoomRef\[0\].ExtraServices\[0\]

By selecting a service and sending it into the validation request, you
can obtain the prices with the extra service selected.

To get offer details with extra services make a POST request to
/v2/hotels/:hotels\_code/:hotel\_id/package/:package\_code/:room\_combination
with params like in example below:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Extra Services Request Example
:::

    extra-services[0][serviceId]:4578
    extra-services[0][rate]:0
    extra-services[0][periods][0][id]:2023-03-07|2023-03-07
    extra-services[0][periods][0][dateStart]:2023-03-07
    extra-services[0][periods][0][dateEnd]:2023-03-07
    extra-services[0][travellers][18-99]:1
:::

When creating an order with extra services send params like in example
below:

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Order with Extra Services Example
:::

    services[hotel][0][room][0][extra-services][0][serviceId]:4578
    services[hotel][0][room][0][extra-services][0][rate]:0
    services[hotel][0][room][0][extra-services][0][periods][0][id]:2023-03-07|2023-03-07
    services[hotel][0][room][0][extra-services][0][periods][0][dateStart]:2023-03-07
    services[hotel][0][room][0][extra-services][0][periods][0][dateEnd]:2023-03-07
    services[hotel][0][room][0][extra-services][0][travellers][18-99]:1
:::

Hotel Orders {#hotel-orders .no-number}
------------

### Add hotel service

To create an order with hotel service, you need to add the service data
from the Select rooms for a package response. The Select rooms for a
package request validates the room combination and retrieves the
information directly from the supplier\'s database.

This JSON makes an order for one room and one adult hotel. If the hotel
offer has many adults/rooms, you need to add the objects for each of
them

### Extra order data - passenger

**Check order - service particularities [here](#offer-configuration)**

::: {.endpoint}
[POST]{.method .post} [/orders]{.url}
:::

### Pay to supplier

Based on supplier configuration, to book a hotel, it might be required
to include the card details in the book process. To know if this is the
case, check the hotel room validation response and if it contains
SupplierPayment, it means you need to submit the data required in the
method book request.

Get Search Result Code {#hotels-get-search-code}
----------------------

After making a hotel search request, you need to retrieve the search
result code to get the actual search results.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/hotels/search/result-code]{.url}
:::

Obtain The Hotels Search List {#hotels-get-list}
-----------------------------

Use the search result code to retrieve the list of available hotels from
your search.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/hotels/search/results/{resultCode}]{.url}
:::

Hotel Details {#hotels-details}
-------------

Get detailed information about a specific hotel including amenities,
policies, and room types.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/hotels/{hotelId}/details]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Hotel Details Parameters

  Parameter   Type     Required   Description
  ----------- -------- ---------- ---------------------------------
  hotelId     string   Yes        Unique identifier for the hotel
  checkIn     date     Yes        Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  checkOut    date     Yes        Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD)
:::

Get hotel room packages list {#hotels-room-packages}
----------------------------

Retrieve available room packages for a specific hotel, including room
types, rates, and availability.

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/hotels/{hotelId}/room-packages]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Room Package Parameters

  Parameter   Type      Description
  ----------- --------- --------------------
  hotelId     string    Hotel identifier
  checkIn     date      Check-in date
  checkOut    date      Check-out date
  rooms       integer   Number of rooms
  adults      integer   Number of adults
  children    integer   Number of children
:::

Select rooms for a package {#hotels-select-rooms}
--------------------------

Room configuration and validation for hotel bookings, including room
selection and guest assignment.

### Room Selection Process

1.  **Choose Room Type:** Select from available room categories
2.  **Specify Occupancy:** Define number of adults and children per room
3.  **Validate Selection:** Confirm room availability and pricing
4.  **Assign Guests:** Provide guest details for each room

::: {.endpoint}
[POST]{.method .post} [/hotels/{hotelId}/rooms/validate]{.url}
:::

### Room Selection Example

::: {.code-example}
::: {.code-header}
Room Selection Request
:::

    services[hotel][0][hotelId]: HTL123456
    services[hotel][0][rooms][0][roomType]: Standard Double
    services[hotel][0][rooms][0][adults]: 2
    services[hotel][0][rooms][0][children]: 0
    services[hotel][0][rooms][0][guests][0][firstName]: John
    services[hotel][0][rooms][0][guests][0][lastName]: Doe
    services[hotel][0][rooms][0][guests][1][firstName]: Jane
    services[hotel][0][rooms][0][guests][1][lastName]: Doe
:::

Extra services {#hotels-extra-services}
--------------

Additional services that can be booked along with hotel accommodation to
enhance the guest experience.

### Available Extra Services

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Hotel Extra Services

  Service Type       Description                            Pricing Model
  ------------------ -------------------------------------- ---------------------------
  Airport Transfer   Transportation to/from airport         Per transfer, per vehicle
  Breakfast          Daily breakfast service                Per person, per day
  Spa Services       Spa treatments and wellness services   Per service, per person
  Late Check-out     Extended check-out time                Per room, flat fee
  Extra Bed          Additional bed in room                 Per bed, per night
:::

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/hotels/{hotelId}/extra-services]{.url}
:::

Hotel Orders {#hotels-orders}
------------

Order service data for hotel might have particularities. Please check
the Orders API documentation for more details. [Go to
Orders](#orders-create)

::: {#activities-service .section .content-section}
Activities Service {#activities-service-title}
==================

### Activity Search & Book Process

1.  [**Search Activities:** Find available activities in a certain
    destination & period](#activities-search)
2.  [**Select Activity:** Get Activity details &
    entries](#activities-details)
3.  [**Validate Offer:** Confirm availability and
    pricing](#activities-details)
4.  [**Create Order:** Initialize the order process\
    Add Guest & Offer Details\
    Select entry & configuration\
    Add extra details if needed](#activities-add-service)
5.  [**Payment:** Process payment](#payment-general)
6.  [**Confirmation:** Receive booking
    confirmation](#orders-get-specific)

Search request {#activities-search}
--------------

::: {.endpoint}
[POST]{.method .post} [/en/dynamic-package]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Activity Search Parameters

  Description            Type   Parameter                                           Value
  ---------------------- ------ --------------------------------------------------- -------
  Destination city       int    \_s\[CSBTActivityCID\]\[a\]\[0\]\[City\]            
  Date start             date   \_s\[CSBTActivityCID\]\[a\]\[0\]\[DateStart\]       
  Date End               date   \_s\[CSBTActivityCID\]\[a\]\[0\]\[DateEnd\]         
  The number of adults   int    \_s\[CSBTActivityCID\]\[a\]\[0\]\[Adults\]          
  Number of Children.    int    \_s\[CSBTActivityCID\]\[a\]\[0\]\[Children\]        
  Children age           int    \_s\[CSBTActivityCID\]\[a\]\[0\]\[ChildAge\]\[0\]   
  Nationality            int    \_s\[CSBTActivityCID\]\[a\]\[0\]\[Nationality\]     
:::

Get Search Result Code {#activities-result-code}
----------------------

::: {.endpoint}
[GET]{.method .get} [/en/dynamic-package/sid/:id]{.url}
:::

::: {.parameters-table}
#### Parameters

  Description                                    Type     Parameter   Value
  ---------------------------------------------- -------- ----------- -------
  The id received in a search request response   string   {\$Id}      
:::

Life property on the response indicates current remaining lifetime in
seconds, meaning in how much time the results for this code will expire.

      "Children": "1",
      "ChildAge": [1 item],
      "Nationality": "182",
      "code": "ACTIVITIES-WS-c45780446d513f061e76c25f1368d0ba"
    }
